newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms CIBC ratings, stable outlooks.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms CIBC ratings, stable outlooks.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said it confirmed its ratings of AA for the senior debt and deposits of the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce and its subsidiaries, with stable outlooks.

The Toronto-based ratings agency said it confirmed CIBC's subordinated debt at AA (low), cumulative preferred shares class A series 4 and 5 at Pfd-1, non-cumulative preferred shares class A series 9 and 12 to 14 at Pfd-1(low) and short-term instruments for CIBC and its subsidiaries at R-1 (middle).
DBRS said its outlook for all ratings were maintained with a stable trend.

It said it confirmed the ratings after CIBC reported record profits in 1996 and called the bank was now among its peers in profitability, with key areas of the balance sheet maintained at favorable levels.
